"""Turn titles into URL slugs."""


import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    # Convert to lowercase
    slug = title.lower()
    
    # Replace non-alphanumeric characters with dashes
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', slug)
    
    # Remove leading and trailing dashes
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    
    return slug
